name: cognitience-wp
description: Cognitience WP — local-first word processor with liquid glass UI, Rust backend, and .cogwp plugins
author: Cognitience

scripts.native: cargo build --release && cargo build --release --manifest-path native-host/Cargo.toml && powershell -NoProfile -Command "Start-Process -FilePath (Resolve-Path 'native-host/target/release/cognition-wp-native.exe') -WindowStyle Normal"
scripts.native:headless: cargo build --release && cargo build --release --manifest-path native-host/Cargo.toml && set COGNITION_NATIVE_HEADLESS_SECS=20&& native-host\target\release\cognition-wp-native.exe --headless
